# دفتر الذكريات — ألبوم بنتي

> A private digital album for parents to capture and organize their children's drawings, certificates, photos, videos, and memories. Behind sign-in.

## Pages

- [الرئيسية](/): Landing — overview of your children and quick links into the album.
- [الألبوم](/album): Browse, filter, and search all memories by child, category, tag, year.
- [إضافة ذكرى](/add): Add a new memory (photo, video, drawing, certificate, note) with AI-assisted title, description, and tags.
- [الفئات](/categories): Browse memories grouped by category.
- [الإعدادات](/settings): Account information and privacy.

## Optional

- [دخول](/auth): Sign-in / sign-up page.
